title: [ty] Use shallow fetches in primer setup
body:
Reproducing a historical ecosystem result currently downloads the repository's full history. Fetch pinned revisions at depth one and initialize recursive submodules after selecting the requested revision, using the commits recorded by their parents.

Add `--full-history` for setup commands that need Git history or tags, abbreviated commit IDs and revision expressions, and servers that reject shallow fetches.
